disaster_recovery.encryption: AES-256 with key managed outside database host

0001_database_identities.rationale: Reversible: drops core, ops, education, and public_library schemas and permissions during initial empty-state rollback.

0002_organizations_rls.rationale: Non-reversible once organizations exist: dropping core.organizations destroys tenant master keys and root tenant identities; requires forward-fix script.

0003_audit_outbox.rationale: Destructive: audit_events and outbox_events are append-only compliance logs prohibited from hard deletion by retention policy.

0004_users_profiles.rationale: Destructive: dropping core.users and core.user_profiles causes permanent loss of user credentials and PII; requires forward-fix script.

0005_refresh_sessions.rationale: Reversible: refresh session state is short-lived; revocation and table drop during rollback safely invalidates active sessions without data corruption.

0006_rbac.rationale: Destructive: dropping roles, permissions, and user assignments destroys tenant access control matrix; requires forward-fix migration.

0007_tenant_context_catalog.rationale: Reversible: drops security catalog stored procedure and verification functions cleanly.

0008_books.rationale: Destructive: dropping core.books causes irreversible bibliographic data loss; forward-fix migration required once catalog is populated.

0009_locations_and_book_copies.rationale: Destructive: dropping physical copy inventory and library locations destroys item barcodes and asset records; requires forward-fix.

0010_copy_status_history.rationale: Destructive: historical copy transition log is required for audit trail; hard deletion prohibited by retention contract.

0011_outbox_claim_jobs.rationale: Reversible: drops ops.claim_outbox_event and ops.job_records without breaking outbox event persistence.

0012_loans.rationale: Destructive: loans and checkout history are subject to statutory financial/asset retention; cannot be dropped; forward-fix required.

0013_idempotency_keys.rationale: Reversible: idempotency keys have 24-hour TTL; dropping table forces fresh evaluations without permanent data loss.

0014_reservations.rationale: Destructive: patron reservation holds and queues cannot be dropped without patron disruption; requires forward-fix.

0015_education_entities.rationale: Destructive: academic courses, classes, reading lists, and student rosters must not be deleted; forward-fix required.

0016_public_library_memberships.rationale: Destructive: active patron membership cards, plans, and subscriptions must be preserved; forward-fix required.

0017_public_library_fines_invoices.rationale: Destructive: ledger fines and invoices are subject to financial accounting regulations; hard deletion prohibited; forward-fix required.

0018_public_library_payment_webhooks.rationale: Destructive: payment transaction records and payment allocations represent financial ledger entries; forward-fix required.

0019_notifications.rationale: Reversible: notifications are delivered representations; dropping table is reversible prior to relying features or can be recreated.
